svg.aria-label: AgentRQ skills: you paste a GitHub link and import three skills, tdd, code-review and release, then turn them on in the api, web and docs workspaces. Each agent, claude, codex and agy, gets a task, finds the skill that matches and loads it; you edit code-review and the one copy updates in every workspace, and the agents finish and celebrate.
